approach: Add one bullet to planner.md and one to critic.md, so a landing, history or attribution plan must derive its rule from an enumerated commit-shape table and demonstrate it on a realistic-branch fixture. Raise the 700-token "short frame" bound in lib.rs and pin the new wording with a new test in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs. Update the two budget lines in docs/system-facts.md, which a test requires, and record the root cause in CHANGELOG.md. No other code or prompt changes.

decisions.choice: Put the rule in planner.md and critic.md, the two stage prompts that derive and review plans.
decisions.reason: The failures began when a plan derived the rule from the happy path. The planner and critic prompts have headroom (planner 966 of 1300, critic 902 of 1300 per docs/system-facts.md). The reader is at 1997 of 2000 and the verifier at 1298 of 1300.

rejected.option: Put the rule in reader.md, so criteria name the fixture.
rejected.why: The reader set has 3 tokens left, and the request leaves reader.md out of scope.

rejected.option: Patch land.rs, gh.rs or reconcile.rs for the three jobs.
rejected.why: That fixes single instances and is out of scope. The brief asks for the cause, which is in the planning stage.

rejected.option: Add a code check that rejects plans lacking the table.
rejected.why: It is out of scope. It would also need a parser for the free-form plan fields.

decisions.choice: Pin exact phrases in both prompts with a test in athena-context/src/lib.rs, following the existing pattern of external_service_calls_need_a_named_state_and_a_wait.
decisions.reason: This is the mechanism that fails the build if the text is removed, and the test cannot pass on the current prompts.

rejected.option: State the rule in prose only.
rejected.why: The mechanism default requires a test or an explicit prose-only mark.

decisions.choice: Raise the `estimate_tokens(frame.text) < 700` bound in planner_and_critic_frames_are_short_and_fit_the_budgets (lib.rs:404) to 900. Keep the 1300 budget check as the real limit.
decisions.reason: The planner frame is now about 640 tokens (1918 bytes) and the critic about 575. The new bullets add about 230 and 140 tokens, which pushes the planner over 700. The bound is a local sanity check, not the budget.

rejected.option: Squeeze the new text into under 180 bytes.
rejected.why: That cannot hold a table requirement, a fixture requirement and the crate-test requirement.
A cap on frame size is worth keeping.

decisions.choice: Also modify docs/system-facts.md, changing only the `budget planner` and `budget critic` lines.
decisions.reason: system_facts_budgets_match_computed (crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs:125) compares those lines with the computed sizes. SYSTEM_FACTS is include_str!'d at briefs.rs:1743. Without the update `cargo test` fails. The file is documentation, not governance. The facts file itself says to update the line, never the budget.

rejected.why: The budgets test would fail, which breaks criterion 7.

files.purpose: Add one bullet. For a landing, history-check or attribution rule: (a) an enumerated commit-shape table of the shapes the real branch contains (job commits, records-only, owner-path, intervention, retry-after-block landing; more from HISTORY.txt), each with the rule's outcome; (b) demonstrations on a fixture of a realistic branch with at least one intervention commit, one records-only commit and the job landing, saying where the fixture differs from the real repository; (c) run the tests of every crate that calls the changed classification functions.

Add one checklist bullet. For a landing, history or attribution plan, raise a major finding when it lacks the commit-shape table, lacks the realistic-branch fixture, or omits the tests of every crate calling the changed classification functions.
Add test landing_history_rules_need_a_commit_shape_table_and_realistic_fixture, with a doc comment naming the class. Raise the 700 bound at line 404 to 900 and update its comment.
Update only the lines `- budget planner: 966 of 1300` and `- budget critic: 902 of 1300` to the computed values, as the facts file instructs and system_facts_budgets_match_computed requires.
Add a bullet under [Unreleased] / Changed naming the root cause, the fix location, the class and the three introspections.

steps: Fix the exact pinned phrases. Planner: "enumerated commit-shape table", "job commits, records-only, owner-path, intervention and retry-after-block landing", "the rule's outcome for each", "fixture of a realistic branch", "one intervention commit, one records-only commit and the job landing", "where the fixture differs from the real repository", "every crate that calls the changed classification functions". Critic: "raise a major finding", "commit-shape table", "realistic-branch fixture", "every crate calling the changed classification functions".

Edit crates/athena-context/prompts/planner.md: append one bullet, after the refusal-rule bullet and before demonstrations or at the end, using the planner phrases. Keep it near 700 bytes and keep every existing bullet verbatim.
Edit crates/athena-context/prompts/critic.md: append one checklist bullet using the critic phrases, near 450 bytes, existing bullets verbatim.

Edit crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs. Add a #[test] landing_history_rules_need_a_commit_shape_table_and_realistic_fixture next to external_service_calls_need_a_named_state_and_a_wait. It loops over the pinned phrases for PLANNER_FRAME.text and CRITIC_FRAME.text with the same assert!(text.contains(w), "... lacks: {w}") pattern, and its doc comment names the class and the three introspections. Change `< 700` at line 404 to `< 900` and update the comment.
Run cargo test -p athena-context. Run cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets and read the computed planner and critic values from its failure message.

Edit docs/system-facts.md: set the `- budget planner:` and `- budget critic:` lines to the computed values and nothing else. Re-run cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets and confirm both budgets tests pass.

Edit CHANGELOG.md: add a bullet under the first [Unreleased] ### Changed section. Name the root cause (a commit-shape rule derived from the happy path, not the full set of shapes the system produces: job, records-only, owner-path, intervention, retry-after-block), the fix location (planner and critic prompts, pinned by the new test) and the class plan-tested-only-against-job-commits-not-realistic-branch-history. Cite introspections 20261024-154443-51wt, 20261024-161503-q0pp and 20261025-012736-2q6w. Say the code of jobs 20261024-153908-1rve, 20261024-154552-e65v and 20261025-012657-hac3 is not changed here, and that the guard is prose pinned by a test.
Run cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo test --locked. Confirm with git status that reader.md, producer.md and verifier.md are untouched.

risks.risk: The new text pushes a prompt set over 1300 tokens. The set is the contract (977 bytes) plus the frame, estimated as ceil(bytes/3), so the limit is about 3900 bytes.
risks.mitigation: Keep the planner bullet to about 700 bytes (set about 1200) and the critic bullet to about 450 bytes (set about 1050). cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets reports the exact sizes.

risks.risk: The pinned phrases drift between the prompts and the test, so the test fails on a typo.
risks.mitigation: Step 1 fixes the exact phrases. The producer copies them verbatim into both the prompt and the test and runs cargo test -p athena-context.

risks.risk: The system-facts budget lines are left stale, so cargo test fails.
risks.mitigation: Step 6 runs the budgets test, takes the computed values from its message, and edits only those two lines.

risks.risk: The new bullet crowds out or contradicts the existing rules in the prompts, for example the seam rule.
risks.mitigation: The bullet only adds; the old bullets stay verbatim and their pins in briefs.rs and lib.rs keep passing.

risks.risk: The prompt text is prose guidance that the model may still ignore, so this is a prose-only guard.
risks.mitigation: The test pins the wording, so it cannot be dropped silently. The CHANGELOG states that compliance rests on the critic's major finding, not on code.

dependents.name: planner and critic budget lines in docs/system-facts.md
dependents.test: cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets. Step 6 sets the two lines to the computed values. The producer reads them from the test failure message, which prints `the computed value is X of Y`.

dependents.name: planner and critic composed token sizes
dependents.test: cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets. Both sets stay under 1300 and the headroom rows are computed from the same compose call.

dependents.name: text of PLANNER_FRAME and CRITIC_FRAME
dependents.dependent: crates/athena-core/src/run/planning.rs lines 136 and 289, which compose PLANNER_FRAME and CRITIC_FRAME into the system prompts
dependents.reason: These sites include the text as an opaque string and parse nothing from it, so a longer prompt changes behavior only through the model. The composed prompt hash changes, which is recorded per job and not compared against a fixed value.

dependents.name: existing planner and critic wording pins
dependents.test: cargo test -p athena-context. The plan only adds text; the pinned phrases ("seam, fake or fixture", "refusal_corpus", "major finding when a demonstration names no seam") stay.

dependents.name: existing external-service wording in both frames
dependents.test: cargo test -p athena-context. The old bullets stay verbatim.

dependents.name: 700-token frame-size bound
dependents.test: cargo test -p athena-context. Step 4 raises the bound to 900; the frames end around 870 and 715 tokens and the 1300 budget check still runs.

dependents.name: planner.md path as a repo file
dependents.dependent: crates/athena-core/tests/refusal_corpus.rs line 167, which lists planner.md only as a repo file name
dependents.reason: The corpus reads only the path, not the content. The plan adds no refusal or matching rule, so no input forms and no corpus cases apply.

dependents.name: banned words and email-like text in the new prompt, test and changelog text
dependents.dependent: xtask/tests/policy.rs boundary_words scan and the athena.toml [personal_data] allow-list over tracked files
dependents.reason: The new text names no person, machine or address; `cargo test --locked` runs the xtask policy tests.

dependents.name: system-facts.md as a brief input
dependents.dependent: docs/system-facts.md and the system-facts section of the briefs, via SYSTEM_FACTS (briefs.rs:1743)
dependents.reason: Only two numbers change. The briefs.rs tests at lines 3633-3680 check that the brief embeds the file and that each fact has a source; they do not depend on the numbers.

demonstrations.method: Run the pinning test; also Grep the planner prompt for the table requirement.

It passes. Grep for "commit-shape table" in crates/athena-context/prompts/planner.md finds the bullet.
demonstrations.fails_without: On the current planner.md none of those phrases exist, so the assertion fails.
demonstrations.seam: The test calls the existing public const PLANNER_FRAME (lib.rs:56), whose text comes from include_str!("../prompts/planner.md"). No fake is used; the real compiled prompt is read. The test is added by step 4.

demonstrations.method: The same pinning test checks the realistic-fixture wording in the planner prompt.
demonstrations.observes: PLANNER_FRAME.text contains "fixture of a realistic branch", "one intervention commit, one records-only commit and the job landing" and "where the fixture differs from the real repository".
demonstrations.fails_without: The current planner.md has none of this wording, so the assertion fails.
demonstrations.seam: PLANNER_FRAME (lib.rs:56) is read directly by the new test from step 4. No double is used.

demonstrations.method: The pinning test checks the critic checklist item.
demonstrations.observes: CRITIC_FRAME.text contains "raise a major finding", "commit-shape table", "realistic-branch fixture" and "every crate calling the changed classification functions".
demonstrations.fails_without: The current critic.md lacks these phrases, so the assertion fails.
demonstrations.seam: CRITIC_FRAME (lib.rs:62) is read directly by the test added in step 4.

demonstrations.method: Read the CHANGELOG.md Unreleased entry and the test's doc comment. Run git diff to confirm the entry is in the change.
demonstrations.observes: A new bullet under [Unreleased] / Changed names the root cause (a commit-shape rule derived from the happy path, not from the full set of shapes the system produces). It names the fix location (the planner and critic prompts) and the class plan-tested-only-against-job-commits-not-realistic-branch-history, with introspections 20261024-154443-51wt, 20261024-161503-q0pp and 20261025-012736-2q6w.

demonstrations.method: Run the budget tests and diff the prompt files that must not change.
demonstrations.observes: system_facts_budgets_match_computed and every_role_set_is_within_its_budget pass. The planner and critic sets each stay at or under 1300, and docs/system-facts.md carries the new sizes. git diff --stat shows no change to reader.md, producer.md or verifier.md.
demonstrations.fails_without: If a set went over 1300, check_budget (lib.rs:222) returns Err and the test panics. If the facts lines were stale, system_facts_budgets_match_computed fails.
demonstrations.seam: The test calls athena_cli::wiring::capabilities and compose/check_budget, which exist today (budgets.rs:21-80). The only new input is the grown prompt text.

demonstrations.method: Run the new test. Before the prompt edits it fails; after them it passes.
demonstrations.observes: The new test landing_history_rules_need_a_commit_shape_table_and_realistic_fixture passes. The loosened planner_and_critic_frames_are_short_and_fit_the_budgets still passes. The test is written against the real PLANNER_FRAME and CRITIC_FRAME and asserts the phrases listed in demonstrations 1 to 3.

demonstrations.seam: Entry points PLANNER_FRAME and CRITIC_FRAME in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs; the fixture is the compiled-in prompt text. Both exist today, and step 4 adds the test function.
